core_philosophy.name: Calibrated Cognitive Friction
core_philosophy.definition: Designing intentional friction in autonomous defense systems to prevent automation bias and enforce Meaningful Human Control (MHC).

evidence: Created the Principles for Agentic Trust framework for auditing non-deterministic AI across Alignment, Execution, Control, and Calibration.
Principles for Agentic Trust was accepted at ACM CSCW 2026 Industry Perspectives.
Led a $50M psychophysics program that replaced arbitrary engineering latency targets with human perceptual thresholds.
Named inventor on US Patent US-12532040-B1 for multimodal interaction architectures.
Applied fNIRS neuroimaging and eye-tracking to cognitive-load modeling.
Performed Human-Systems Integration validation for Lunar Gateway clinical workstations.
Applied uFMEA, NASA-STD-3001, and MIL-STD-1472 guidance.
Studied Level 2 and Level 3 autonomous handovers using biometric, haptic, and auditory feedback in simulator studies.
